about_the_game:
Koro-san just keeps hitting home runs!

Koro-san loves baseball, so she invited all the Hololive Gamers to play baseball.

But it seems everyone wants to be the pitcher.

The listeners will be in charge of defense, and Koro-san will just hit the ball to his heart's content!

How to Play

All Koro-san's has to do is hit home runs!

Smack down the magic pitches thrown by the other Gamers and their fans!

Keep swinging until you reach the required number of home runs for each stage.

Clear all the stages, and someone unexpected might show up...!?

Stats

Use the bread you earn in each stage to power up Korosan!

Keep training to become a true home run slugger!

RTA Mode

An RTA (Real-Time Attack) mode is included with time tracking!

Even the time spent powering up feels like a waste!

Push for the fastest clear time possible!
